cues: Stand the cylinder in a big water bath and let it expand very slowly.
Heat flows in just fast enough to keep the temperature fixed.
No temperature change means delta U is zero, so Q equals W.
The curve is P V equals constant, a rectangular hyperbola.
text: Third, isothermal: constant temperature. Stand the cylinder in a big water bath and let it expand very slowly. Heat flows in just fast enough to keep the temperature fixed. No temperature change means delta U is zero, so Q equals W. The curve is P V equals constant, a rectangular hyperbola.
